title: GitHub policy runtime parity rate-limit backoff

phases.objective: Make GitHub review-policy readiness respect bounded Production runtime rate limiting instead of repeatedly hammering identity endpoints, while preserving exact-SHA fail-closed parity and zero mutation authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The existing GitHub review-policy readiness runner verifies the exact protected Production runtime before any Ruleset plan or Apply.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: HTTP 429 responses honor Retry-After within the existing six-minute parity window, use a bounded fallback delay when Retry-After is absent, and emit secret-free final status diagnostics without weakening exact SHA or branch stability checks.
steps: Keep the exact main and Production ref pins and repository-policy source parity checks unchanged.
Capture Retry-After from bounded GET-only health, version, and deployment-info probes.
Back off 429 probes for at least the provider-requested interval when it fits inside the fixed parity window, otherwise wait only through the remaining window and fail closed.
Record only attempt count, last HTTP statuses, rate-limit observation, maximum Retry-After delay, and the fixed parity window on terminal failure.
Keep Ruleset Apply, database, migration, provider, Hostinger, and Production mutation disabled in this maintenance change.
Register only the new backoff/diagnostic literals as permanent non-secret configuration-drift baseline extensions; do not suppress drift.
assertions: The runtime parity window remains bounded to six minutes and at most 24 probe attempts.
429 responses cannot trigger the old fixed 15-second retry loop.
Retry-After values are parsed as delta-seconds or HTTP dates and never expose response bodies or credentials.
Successful parity still requires health ok plus exact Production SHA evidence in both version and deployment-info.
Terminal failure remains fail-closed with runtime_parity_not_converged and secrets_included=false.
No GitHub Ruleset Apply, provider mutation, Hostinger mutation, database mutation, migration Apply, force push, or Production ref mutation is authorized.
All new configuration candidates introduced by this maintenance patch are explicitly governed baseline extensions with runtime and Production mutation authority false.
